eyebrow: Data Modeling & Data Warehousing · Chapter 7, Lesson 31
subtitle: Turning the whiteboard star schema into real SQL Server tables

code:
CREATE TABLE dbo.Dim_Product (
  ProductKey INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
  ProductAlternateKey VARCHAR(25) NOT NULL,
  ProductName NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  Category NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  Subcategory NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT PK_Dim_Product
    PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (ProductKey)
);
caption: Surrogate key first; natural key kept as a plain column for ETL lookups.

eyebrow: Fact table — built for narrow, fast rows
code:
CREATE TABLE dbo.Fact_Sales (
  SalesOrderKey BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
  DateKey INT NOT NULL,        -- FK -> Dim_Date
  ProductKey INT NOT NULL,     -- FK -> Dim_Product
  CustomerKey INT NOT NULL,    -- FK -> Dim_Customer
  SalesAmount DECIMAL(19,4) NOT NULL,
  Quantity INT NOT NULL
);
caption: Surrogate-key foreign keys, decimal measures, and an INT YYYYMMDD date key.
